description: This file defines a ViewModel class 'DashboardViewModel' for managing UI-related data and logic for a calculator dashboard in an Android application. It handles input validation, performs basic arithmetic operations, and exposes LiveData for UI updates.

classes.name: DashboardViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel handling calculation logic, input validation, and exposing LiveData for calculator UI.

methods.name: onOperation
methods.description: Performs an arithmetic operation after input validation and updates LiveData with the result or error messages.

methods.name: onClear
methods.description: Resets all input errors, general errors, and the result display.
